To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

routing in wireless mesh network requires a different approach than in other wireless networks, such as ad hoc, sensor and mobile ad hoc networks, because of its unique characteristics and that the key design features are: multi-path, multi-hop and multi-channel routing.

WMNs are a special case of MANETs, which require a special solution; the existing routing protocols for WMNs are not efficient; and the existing routing protocols in ad hoc and sensor networks are not suitable for WMNs.

the routing protocols in wireless mesh network should be designed with the following characteristics: (1) scalability to a large number of nodes, (2) low overhead, (3) high throughput, (4) high reliability, (5) high energy efficiency, (6) high adaptability to the dynamic nature of wireless networks and (7) support for multiple traffic classes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: What makes routing in WMNs different?
the design and development of routing protocols for WMNs.
the design and evaluation of routing protocols in wireless mesh networking.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
WMNs require a new set of routing protocols that take advantage of the unique characteristics of this technology.

WMNs require a specific routing solution that takes advantage of the unique characteristics of the network, such as wireless backbone and meshing, and the specific application requirements, such as quality of service and mobility support.

the routing protocols for wireless mesh networks should be designed based on the unique characteristics of these networks, and that the routing metrics should be designed based upon the application requirements.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
WMN routing protocols should be designed to be robust, efficient, and scalable.
we identify and analyze the key characteristics of WMNs, which have a strong impact in the design of WMN routing protocols.

routing protocols for WMNs should: 1) provide multi-path routing; 2) support load balancing; 3) be scalable to large networks; 4) be robust to link failures and node mobility; 5) be energy efficient; 6) support QoS requirements; 7) be simple and easy to implement; and 8) be robust against attacks.
The main takeaway from our work is that
routing in WMNs should not be considered a simple extension of routing for ad hoc networks.
the existing routing protocols are not well-suited for WMNs.

WMN routing protocols should be designed to address the unique characteristics of mesh networking, and should be able to support a wide range of applications, including real-time and multimedia applications.
